name: Chrono Harem: Artifact of Syr
source:
Chrono Harem: Artifact of Syr is a story-rich adult dating sim that takes you on a journey across two parallel timelines. Travel freely between the present and a mysterious sci-fi future, uncovering secrets, building relationships, and shaping your destiny.

[From [url=https://mynomyni.itch.io/chrono-harem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Chrono Harem: Artifact of Syr》是一部劇情豐富的成人戀愛模擬遊戲，帶你展開一場穿梭於兩條平行時間線的旅程。在當下與神秘的科幻未來之間自由往來，發掘秘密、與人建立關係，塑造自己的命運。

［摘自[url=https://mynomyni.itch.io/chrono-harem]itch.io[/url]］
